declaredIdentity: Deterministic tenant + program + commitment identity + control identity tuple (same scheme as RiskTreatmentAssertion); `LinkId` must equal that tuple; later commands use CommandId with the exact commitment version and control version.
invariant: One commitment-to-control link has one pending/accepted version line: each accepted version binds an exact commitment version to an exact control version with rationale, a successor needs independent review, and a retired link stays terminal (M0-D09 D09-09). Neither CommitmentDraft nor ControlDraft owns the other side's version list.

logicalIdentity.rule: caller-supplied immutable creation identity: an exact retry with the same id and authored intent returns the original result; the same id with changed intent is refused; a different id is a different record
CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused
CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused
